title: Build Your First AI Agent in Java with Claude (Step by Step)
subtitle: An AI agent is just an LLM, some tools and a loop. Here's how to build one in plain Java with the official Anthropic SDK, no framework needed.
captions: The agent loop: repeat while stop_reason is TOOL_USE
Without tools, Claude can't see your clock
The pom.xml with the official Anthropic Java SDK
The tools are plain Java methods that return text
The description tells Claude when to use the tool
run() maps the tool name to a Java method
The conversation holds the model, the tools and the question
All tool results go back in one message
Claude asked for both tools, Java ran them, and Claude answered
